Title: Send worker OTP with null worker object
Preconditions: User is authenticated and has a shop
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/shops/{shopId}/workers/sendOtp with a null worker object in the request body.

Test Data: {"worker": null}
Expected Result: The API responds with a 400 Bad Request status code and an error message indicating that the worker object cannot be null.

Title: Successfully send worker OTP when a pending shop request exists
Preconditions: A pending shop change or add worker request exists for the authenticated shop owner account.
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/shops/1/workers/sendOtp with the JSON payload in testData.

Test Data: {
  "name": "John Worker",
  "email": "worker@example.com",
  "phone": "+1234567890",
  "role": "TAILOR"
}
Expected Result: HTTP 201 Created status code with a JSON response body containing: {"status": "success", "message": "Otp Send Successfully"}

Title: Successfully set PIN and assign worker role for a worker user type
Preconditions: A user with phone number '+1234567890' exists with userType set to 'worker', and a valid OTP has been requested for this phone number.
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/auth/set-pin with the JSON payload in testData.

Test Data: {
  "phoneNumber": "+1234567890",
  "otp": "123456",
  "pin": "1234",
  "confirmPin": "1234"
}
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK status code with a JSON response body containing: {"status": "success", "message": "PIN set successfully"}

Title: Attempt to send worker OTP when no pending shop change request exists for the authenticated user
Preconditions: The current authenticated user is logged in but does not have an active or pending shop change request.
Expected Result: The system rejects the request and throws an error with the message "You have no add worker request".

Title: Verify that requesting a worker OTP without an active pending shop change request is rejected
Section: Worker Management - OTP Generation Access Control
Preconditions: A shop owner user is authenticated with a valid JWT token, but has no pending worker addition or shop change request registered.
Expected Result: The system rejects the request and throws an error with message 'You have no add worker request'. No OTP is generated or saved for the specified email.
